notes: 0–39 / 40–49 / XP / miss values are PLACEHOLDERS; 50–59 = 12 and 60+ = 15 confirmed.
FG splits NFL.com through Wk2 (ATL/GB through Thu). Team FGA / offensive TDs FootballDB + NFL.com.
